'''Montem al'San''' is a young man from the [[Two Rivers]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Montem al'San}} 

== Activities ==
He is one of the Two Rivers men that now follows [[Perrin Aybara]] in [[Ghealdan]]. He acts as Perrin's bodyguard when Perrin goes to survey the [[Children of the Light]] camp.

== Trivia ==
* Montem al'San is named for Shawn Montgomery, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
